{{Quote|Hey, guys, Jabba didn't get where he is today without having a sense of humor. Relax.|Nuendo Rash|<ref name="WNTD" />}}
'''Nuendo Rash''' was a the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He owed twenty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] which resulting in several of Jabba's enforcers firing at the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In retaliation, Rash dropped several [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] onto [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] against the advice of his crew, the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] [[Hutch (cyborg)|Hutch]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kaoln]].<ref name="WNTD" /> Rash once planned to carry medical supplies to [[Fortress Keremark]] on the planet [[Risban]]. He was arrested shortly after tying to reassure his crew about the job in [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]] cantina on [[Stend VI]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
